notes.title: Linux version release
notes.notes: [p]We have made a Linux compatible version of Neon Colony. [/p][p]In order to try it out, select the Legacy runtime 1.0 compatibility tool and run the game. [/p][p]If any problems occur, please run steam via the terminal and look at the output. Sending me the logging helps a lot with debugging![/p]

notes.title: Demo for Neon Colony released
notes.notes: [p]Do you find choosing a character difficult?[/p][p]Is being able to set the planet inhospitality to levels higher than 10 making you dizzy?[/p][p]Do you like playing with at most a single lane?[/p][p]Are you hating the drag of Endless Mode?[/p][p][/p][p]Don't worry![/p][p][/p][p]Neon Corp is proud to present the official NEON COLONY DEMO![/p][p]For those who just want to dip their toes in corporate greed. Come on, try it! What's the worst that could happen?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We had planned to release the demo at the same time as the game, but we ran into some store page issues, causing some delays. But thank you to everyone who took a leap of faith and tried the game without being able to test it first![/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Update #7: The Great AI Purge
notes.notes: [p]We have finally gotten around to removing the (to be honest quite random) AI generated background images with amazing cover art made by Crumpaloo ([url="https://ko-fi.com/crumpaloo"]https://ko-fi.com/crumpaloo[/url]).[/p][p]In one fell swoop, Neon Colony is now officially free of any AI shenanigans! Neon Corp might be greedy, and immoral, and a destructive force in the universe that knows no equal, but it has not lost (all of) its humanity, darn it![/p][p]Neon Corp = Human Corp <3[/p]

notes.title: Update Patch #5: The Towers
notes.notes: [p]In this patch, we aimed to redress the balance between generic damage modifiers like MONEY SHOT and tower upgrades. In practice, ALL TOWER UPGRADES have been made MUCH CHEAPER, while generic damage boosts have been made more expensive (certainly the highest perk ranks). Other changes include:[/p][list][*][p]UTILITY FOG grant much more scrap[/p][/*][*][p]CORROSIVE CRYSTALS now grants +5 SHIELD MULTIPLIER[/p][/*][*][p]CORROSIVE CRYSTALS now correctly applied to new tower[/p][/*][*][p]PYROMANIAC text now states correct FIRESTARTER damage[/p][/*][*][p]SHIELD MULTIPLIER from WAVE REWARDS is now actually given to towers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed CHARACTER SCREEN crash when having screen open when finishing wave[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed BOSS HEALTHBAR being insanely big in IH 20[/p][/*][*][p]FLAME TOWER bullets emerge more slowly. This does not affect damage but helps with performance.[/p][/*][*][p]IH 20 made easier:[/p][list][*][p]ELITES spawn first at WAVE 15 instead of 10[/p][/*][*][p]BOSSES get stronger from WAVE 20 instead of 15[/p][/*][*][p]ENEMY SPEED increase from WAVE 25 instead of 20[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]GENERICO PRIME enemies above WAVE 30 do not scale so rapidly anymore[/p][/*][*][p]RESOURCE TOOLTIPS made more informative, putting flavor text below the information[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Update Patch #3: Elites and Ultimates
notes.notes: [h1]New endgame content[/h1][p]We have added 5 new IH levels for characters that have already finished the game at IH 15. These new levels add increased difficulty at higher waves, leaving the early game up to wave 15 about the same as in lower IH levels. Maybe the final boss at IH 20 can succeed where so many of his kin have failed and actually outscale the player.[/p][list][*][p]Added IH 16-20 for characters which have finished the game at IH 15. Unlocked per GREED level.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added golden ELITE enemies that spawn in IH 15 +. They are 10x as strong as their regular variant, worth 10x as much scrap and do 5x as much damage to your city.[/p][/*][*][p]Large floats are now formatted better, with numbers up to 999 quadrillion formatted using a suffix and larger numbers rendered in scientific notation (i.e. 5.6e-21).[/p][/*][*][p]GROWING PAINS is capped at 20x damage.[/p][/*][*][p]MONEY SHOT and SHRAPNEL BLAST grant twice as much % damage per credit / scrap.[/p][/*][*][p]SKIP GRADES is more expensive.[/p][/*][*][p]TUTORIAL is made much easier, with enemies weaker and SCRAPYARDS giving more scrap per wave.[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltip for GREED levels in start menu, explaining the concept.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new names to game testers list.[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional information to the HINT about BOSSES, telling the player where bosses will spawn (at the location of last placed tile and if no tile is placed at spawnpoint geometrically furthest from the city).[/p][/*][*][p]Added RESET HINTS button to SETTINGS MENU.[/p][/*][*][p]GOD OF WASTE now in addition to its previous effect grants 10% damage per scrapyard.[/p][/*][*][p]RESOURCEFUL now in addition to its previous effect grant % damage equal to primary resource of towers using resources.[/p][/*][*][p]EXOTIC TREASURES grant 10x as much scrap per enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]GAME PERFORMANCE boosted by further reduction of text that has to be rendered every frame.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more information to the END GAME RESULT MENU, like number of scrapyards, wave rewards etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game crashing when trying to remove CLOSE button of WAVE MENU.[/p][/*][*][p]REMOVE WAVE REWARD made more visually intuitive, with wave rewards marked red when you can remove them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new SPEED LIMIT perk that sets a maximum speed for all enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed RUIN BUFFS showing up in the CHARACTER MENU during the next run.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed RUIN BUFFS now showing up immediately in CHARACTER MENU.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed BEADS AND SHELLS having 16 ranks, which is too many: you cannot remove the last enemy type from the game.[/p][/*][*][p]RE-ROLLING a TILE is more expensive at higher waves.[/p][/*][*][p]CARTOGRAPHER max rank now causes TILES that have been RE-ROLLED to be removed from the list of possibles tiles for the current wave.[/p][/*][*][p]GOING INFINITE no longer an ULTIMATE perk. Also fixed the chance of going infinite being too low.[/p][/*][*][p]RESEARCH STATION and STOCKBROKERS are more expensive.[/p][/*][*][p]When placing a TOWER, you now see the tower with a red overlay when it is illegal to place it, instead of seeing nothing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug when trying to place 4 tile sized towers at end of map.[/p][/*][*][p]APPLIED RESEARCH and EXPLOIT WEAKNESS changed places, with APPLIED RESEARCH now an ULTIMATE perk and more expensive. EXPLOIT WEAKNESS is cheaper.[/p][/*][*][p]ECONOMIC VICTORY perk is only half as powerful now (up to 12.5x damage).[/p][/*][*][p]COLD FUSION now functioning as advertised.[/p][/*][*][p]Added red flashing of HP when CITY takes damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update Patch #2: Balance of the Perks
notes.notes: [h2]Major overhaul of perk system[/h2][p]The purpose of the overhaul was to provide more unique playing styles and to put a lid on credit inflation. There were so many sources of credits that it became rather easy to buy out the whole shop in the end game. We hope that the current implementation will make player choice more impactful.[/p][p]New perks have been added:[/p][list][*][p]RENEWABLES[/p][/*][*][p]NETWORK EFFECTS[/p][/*][*][p]SURGEON STUDIES[/p][/*][*][p]BLOODLETTING[/p][/*][*][p]SCARAB GOD[/p][/*][*][p]STEROIDS[/p][/*][*][p]KRYPTONITE[/p][/*][/list][p]But many perks have also been made mutually exclusive.[/p][p]In addition, only one ultimate perk can be selected per shop tab (so one from Economy, one from Research etc.).[/p][p]Many perks have also been made cheaper or more expensive.[/p][p]Commission fees for the market have also been raised significantly.[/p][p]Trash and HP based perks have on average been made cheaper, while credit-related perks are more expensive.[/p][p]Highlights have been added to all objects.[/p][p]When placing a RADAR TOWER, REFINERY or RESEARCH STATION, towers or oil pumps in range are now highlighted.[/p][p]Any object with a range will show this when the mouse is hovering over that object.[/p][p]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS should now function.[/p][p]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS have unique, lovingly crafted icons.[/p][p]When opting to destroy a ruin, the correct image now shows.[/p][p]End of wave menu now also has a list of HP gains.[/p][p]End of Wave menu now has symbolic buttons for rerolling and removing.[/p][p]Removing a reward can now be performed in addition to picking a reward.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update Patch #1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*][Money Shot], [Shrapnel Blast] and [Growing Pains] now mutually exclusive.
[*][Money Shot], [Shrapnel Blast] and [Growing Pains] have a 6th rank allowing them to scale up to 100x damage.
